name: reclaim
description: Build and maintain Reclaim Protocol data verification providers from your editor: capture a site's network traffic, synthesize a provider recipe, replay it, run a zkTLS proof, and publish it. Also inspects verification sessions and diagnoses failed ones. Use when verifying a data point about a user — a follower count, an account balance, an order history. Bundles the Reclaim MCP server, whose how_it_works tool serves the authoring guide one topic at a time.

interface.shortDescription: Build, test, and fix Reclaim data verification providers
interface.longDescription: Verify data points about your users, such as a follower count, an account balance, or an order history. The Reclaim MCP server captures a site's network traffic, synthesizes a provider, replays it, runs a zkTLS proof, and publishes it. It also sets up your organization, tokens, and callbacks, and diagnoses failed verification sessions.
